description: Role-permission matrix. PRD F-024, SEC-002, SEC-003. Security boundaries are sites and libraries, never item-level unique permissions except by approved exception (PRD C-006).
principles: Access is granted only through Entra groups. Direct user permissions are reported as exceptions (PRD F-024).
Editing a document never confers authority to publish or approve it.
Platform administration never confers content-approval authority (PRD SEC-003, persona objection).
Approval Evidence is written by the automation identity only; no interactive role has Contribute on it (PRD F-010).
External sharing is disabled on controlled sites by default (PRD F-025, SEC-005).

customPermissionLevels.name: DMS Approve
customPermissionLevels.ration: Lets approvers set native content approval and see minor versions without the ability to delete controlled content.

customPermissionLevels.name: DMS Contribute No Delete
customPermissionLevels.rationale: Authors and business users must not delete controlled documents or operational records. Removal is a lifecycle action, not a delete. PRD F-020 forbids a UI delete substituting for disposition.

customPermissionLevels.name: DMS Records Control
customPermissionLevels.rationale: Records Managers administer retention and disposition without full site control.

customPermissionLevels.name: DMS Read Evidence
customPermissionLevels.rationale: Auditors need version history for lifecycle reconstruction. PRD NFR-012.

roles.description: All eligible employees and contractors who consume controlled information.

permissions.note: Draft visibility is set to Approver, so readers cannot see minor versions. PRD F-004, A-008.
Record access is granted to the business process audience, not to all readers.
Anyone may raise a change request. PRD F-007.

mustNotBeAbleTo: See any minor version or draft
See Superseded or Withdrawn content in a default view
Approve their own or any content

roles.description: Subject-matter reviewers who verify technical accuracy for an assigned revision.

permissions.note: Needed to see the minor version under review. Review decisions are recorded as Approval Evidence by automation, not by editing the document.

roles.description: Accountable approvers who accept business, quality, legal or risk accountability.
mustNotBeAbleTo: Activate a revision ahead of its effective date

roles.description: Administer the document lifecycle day to day.
mustNotBeAbleTo: Change retention labels or dispose records
Approve content where they are the sole author

roles.description: Govern the file plan, retention labels, record state and disposition.
roles.purviewNote: Purview role assignment is a separate compliance-portal action, not a SharePoint permission. See docs/PURVIEW_DESIGN.md.
mustNotBeAbleTo: Apply a regulatory-record label without the separate authorisation gate

roles.description: Maintain configuration, provisioning, solutions and monitoring.
mustNotBeAbleTo: Be assigned as a content approver by default
roles.separationNote: Full Control is a technical necessity for provisioning. The compensating control is that platform administrators are NOT members of Approvers or RecordsManagers, approval routes never resolve to this group, and their administrative actions are audited. PRD SEC-003, SEC-011.

roles.description: Sample control operation and evidence. Read-only everywhere.
The identity that Power Automate connections and provisioning automation run as. Not a human group.

permissions.note: The ONLY principal with write access to Approval Evidence.

ownership.requirement: PRD SEC-004 and ADM-008 require at least two administrative co-owners and no sole personal owner.

mustNotBeAbleTo: Hold credentials stored in the repository
Have Full Control on the site

roles.description: Optional. Guest access to a defined subset of controlled content.
roles.status: Not provisioned in MVP. Requires an approved sharing exception. PRD F-025, SEC-005, OQ-08.

negativeTestMatrix.description: Drives tests/security. Each entry is an assertion that MUST fail for the named role. PRD 28.2.
